authorization: Wave 5C Route A explicitly authorizes the separately frozen bargaining-only campaign after a fresh hostile pre-fit audit passes.

scope.model_a_definition: P(next action, offer and stop | role-visible pre-action state and history)
scope.model_c_role: fixed diagnostic comparator only on observed bargaining response decisions

extraction.grouping: consecutive game_id; a repeated closed game_id is fatal
extraction.at_risk_unit: one recognized bargaining action by the modeled acting role
extraction.stop_target: 1 on accept/walkaway or a final observed action at the public horizon; 0 on a recognized nonfinal action; otherwise censored
extraction.missing_callback_rule: a final nonterminal action before the public horizon is censored and is never relabelled rejection or stopping

base_features: last offered share to actor and missingness flag
feature_contract.private_information_rule: deltas enter only when complete_information is true and they exist in the public configuration; hidden deltas are zero plus a missingness flag
feature_contract.categorical_effects: ridge actor and canonical-config intercept effects fitted only for training keys; an unseen evaluation key receives exactly zero effect

actor_axis.assignment: existing glee_eval.population.crossfit.build_manifest: identities ordered by (SHA256, raw identity), assigned index modulo 3
actor_axis.evaluation_rule: five acting identities per fold; no evaluation actor coefficient may be fitted or serialized

config_axis.assignment: SHA256(canonical public bargaining configuration) first 16 hex digits modulo 4
config_axis.evaluation_rule: no evaluation canonical-config coefficient may be fitted or serialized

folds.oof_rule: every extracted row is scored exactly once on actor axis and exactly once on config axis

inner_selection.score: unweighted mean over games of joint next-action log loss, observed stop log loss, and observed-offer discretized negative log likelihood

candidate.factorization: coherent binary chain P(offer), P(accept|response), P(walkaway|nonaccept response), plus a separate stop hazard
candidate.heads: ridge-logistic sparse coordinate Newton with deterministic backtracking
candidate.offer_distribution: ridge linear location on logit share plus a training-fold residual empirical quantile CDF mapped through logistic
candidate.tie_break: larger ridge, then shorter history, then fewer residual bins
candidate.nonconvergence_rule: failed component and failed formulation; predictions may be serialized only for audit, never used to rescue the verdict

operational_v1.fallback_rule: missing responder share uses probability 0.5 and increments fallback; total fallback above 5% fails

model_c.estimand_match: acceptance after a visible bargaining offer only
model_c.role: diagnostic comparator, never a replacement for the v1 gate

bootstrap.actor_axis: resample acting identities, then games nested inside sampled identity
bootstrap.config_axis: resample canonical configurations, then games nested inside sampled configuration

next_action_and_stop.required: candidate-minus-v1 log-loss and Brier means and 95% upper bounds all below zero
next_action_and_stop.next_action_calibration: one-vs-rest for every frozen class; a class with no outcome variation fails

offer.required: candidate-minus-v1 CRPS mean and 95% upper bound below zero; normalized MAE improves

trajectory.definition: teacher-forced observed-prefix hazard reconstruction per role; no future state enters any row prediction
trajectory.terminal_round: candidate-minus-v1 absolute expected-terminal-round error mean and 95% upper bound below zero
trajectory.action_count: candidate-minus-v1 energy-score mean and 95% upper bound below zero

metrics_and_gate.rescue_prohibited: no pooled role, axis, subgroup, metric or comparator can rescue a failed mandatory cell

resource_ceiling.fold_processes: one fold per process, run serially to keep one implementation owner and bounded memory
resource_ceiling.limit_result: failed formulation, never permission to relax

independent_prefit_audit.requirement: a fresh auditor who did not implement Route A must hash this exact contract/code, attack leakage/folds/formulas/resources, and issue a separate signed evidence record before root GO

post_outcome_change_policy: Any model, target, feature, split, grid, seed, endpoint, threshold, comparator or formula change after corpus extraction closes this formulation as failed and requires a newly identified route.
